description: This file is a test configuration file using pytest for a FastAPI application. It sets environment variables, defines fixtures for test setup including database environment verification, application initialization, and HTTP client setup. It also contains utility functions for user registration and authorization headers used in testing the backend API.

methods.name: Iterator[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] event_loop()
methods.description: Creates and yields an asyncio event loop for the test session.

methods.name: None _ensure_db_env()
methods.description: Ensures that the database environment variables are set for the tests, skipping tests if configuration is missing.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[FastAPI] app()
methods.description: Initializes and yields the FastAPI application after setting up the database schema.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncClient] client(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Provides an AsyncHTTPX client for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: register_user(client: AsyncClient, email: str = None, password: str = "password123!", org_name: str = None)
methods.description: Utility function to register a new user via the API for testing purposes.

methods.name: dict auth_headers(token: str | None)
methods.description: Generates authorization headers for authenticated requests during tests.

ctags.name: fastapi_app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as fastapi_app$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def register_user(client: AsyncClient, email: str = None, password: str = "password123!", /
ctags.signature: (client: AsyncClient, email: str = None, password: str = "password123!", org_name: str = None)
